finding: tests/test_pipeline_walk.py:196 The P7 identity matrix does not prove that a changed chart descendant invalidates completion.
rationale: The completed-case matrix only deletes the whole charts directory; because that mutation also fails an existence-only implementation, it does not exercise the distinct descendant path that production hashes by relative path, kind, and file content, and no other test requires a descendant mutation to cause P7 invalidation plus README demotion.

evidence.output: P7_OUTPUT_MUTATIONS mutates findings.json, report.md, unresolved.md, removes findings/charts with shutil.rmtree, and mutates charts.json; it never changes, adds, removes, or changes the kind of a charts descendant.

test_changed_or_missing_p7_output_demotes_completion_and_readme applies only P7_OUTPUT_MUTATIONS, then asserts paused at gate_b, invalidated_from == P7, Status: active, Last completed phase: P6, and removal of the outputs block.

_completion_identity separately requires findings/charts to be a directory, recursively enumerates descendants, rejects symlinks and unsupported kinds, hashes directory markers, and hashes each descendant file's relative path, kind, and bytes.

The only pipeline-walk mutations are whole-directory removal and replacing charts with a non-directory before initial P7; test_report.py exercises chart generation/idempotence and stale-file cleanup, but no test mutates a completed chart descendant and asserts workflow invalidation or README demotion.
